select pbi.face_url faceUrl,pbi.name name,pbi.gender gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,pbi.birthday,CURDATE()) AS age, pbi.birthday, pbi.mobile mobile, pbi.medical_number medicalNumber,pmi.member_type_id memberTypeId, pmi.card_number cardNumber,ppi.prepayment_number prepaymentNumber, cast(IFNULL(pmi.principal_amount,0) as decimal(15,2)) principalAmount, cast(IFNULL(pmi.bonus_amount,0) as decimal(15,2)) bonusAmount, cast(IFNULL(ppi.prepayment_principal,0) as decimal(15,2)) prepaymentPrincipal, cast(IFNULL(ppi.prepayment_bonus,0) as decimal(15,2)) prepaymentBonus, cast(IFNULL(pmi.principal_amount + pmi.bonus_amount,0) as decimal(15,2)) memberCardMoneySum, cast(IFNULL(ppi.prepayment_principal + ppi.prepayment_bonus,0) as decimal(15,2)) prepaymentsMoneySum, pmi.crt_time as crtTime pmi.inservice from patient_base_info pbi left join ( select * from patient_prepayments_info where type=1 ) ppi on pbi.id = ppi.patient_id left join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id where pbi.id = #{id}

select pbio.id,pbio.origin_id patientId,pbio.name,pbio.gender,pbio.mobile,pbio.crt_time crtTime from patient_base_info pbio where pbio.origin_id = #{form.patientId} and pbio.origin_type = 2 order by pbio.crt_time desc

select pbio.id patientId, ifnull(pbio2.RecomQty, 0) as 'RecomQty', ifnull(pkr2.KinQty, 0) as 'KinQty' from patient_base_info pbio left join ( select pbio.origin_id, count(*) as 'RecomQty' from patient_base_info pbio where pbio.origin_type = 2 group by pbio.origin_id ) pbio2 on pbio.id = pbio2.origin_id left join ( select pkr.patient_id, count(*) as 'KinQty' from patient_kin_relation pkr group by pkr.patient_id ) pkr2 on pbio.id = pkr2.patient_id

select pbio.id,pbio.origin_id patientId,pbio.name,pbio.gender,pbio.mobile,pbio.crt_time crtTime from patient_base_info pbio where pbio.origin_id = #{form.patientId} and pbio.origin_type = #{form.originType} order by pbio.crtTime desc

SELECT pbi.id, pbi.`name`, pbi.face_url AS faceUrl, pbi.mobile AS mobile, pbi.mobile_owner AS mobileOwner, pbi.medical_number AS medicalNumber, pbi.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF( YEAR, pbi.birthday, CURDATE()) AS age FROM patient_base_info pbi WHERE concat(IFNULL(pbi.`name`,''), IFNULL(pbi.medical_number,''), IFNULL(pbi.pinyin_name,''), IFNULL(pbi.mobile,'')) like concat(concat('%', rtrim(#{form.condition})), '%') AND pbi.has_died = false AND pbi.inservice = 1 ORDER BY ABS( LENGTH( pbi.`name` ) - LENGTH( #{form.condition} ))

select
from patient_base_info where id = #{id}

select
from patient_base_info where id = #{patientId}

select distinct pbi.id, pbi.org_id as orgId, pbi.`name`, pbi.pinyin_name as pinyinName, pbi.mobile, pbi.medical_number as medicalNumber, pbi.gender, pbi.age, pbi.birthday, pbi.remarks, pei.patient_kind as patientKind, pei.useful_phone as usefulPhone, pei.identity, pei.profession, pei.heredity, pei.other_health as otherHealth, pmi.member_type_id as memberTypeId from patient_base_info pbi left join patient_exp_info pei on pbi.id = pei.patient_id left join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id where pbi.id = #{id}

select pbi.id, pbi.org_id as orgId, pbi.`name`, pbi.pinyin_name as pinyinName, pbi.mobile, pbi.medical_number as medicalNumber, pbi.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF( YEAR, pbi.birthday, CURDATE()) AS age, pbi.birthday, pbi.remarks, pei.patient_kind as patientKind, pei.useful_phone as usefulPhone, pei.identity, pei.profession, pei.heredity, pei.other_health as otherHealth, IF(pc.num IS NULL, 0, 1) AS isCommunicate, IFNULL(pmi.member_type_id,mi.member_type_id) as memberTypeId
from patient_base_info pbi left join patient_exp_info pei on pbi.id = pei.patient_id left join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id
LEFT JOIN ( select min(pmi.member_type_id) as member_type_id,pmr.secondary_card_id as secondary_card_id from patient_member_info pmi INNER JOIN patient_member_relation pmr on pmi.patient_id = pmr.master_card_id GROUP by pmr.secondary_card_id ) mi on pbi.id = mi.secondary_card_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(id) AS num, patient_id FROM patient_communication WHERE inservice = 1 GROUP BY patient_id ) pc ON pc.patient_id = pbi.id where pbi.id in
#{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT ignore INTO patient_base_info ( id, org_id, NAME, pinyin_name, mobile, mobile_owner, gender, age, birthday, origin_type, origin_id, remarks, inservice, crt_id, crt_name ) VALUES(#{id},#{orgId},#{name},#{pinyinName},#{mobile},#{mobileOwner},#{gender}, (CASE IFNULL(#{birthday},false) WHEN false THEN null ELSE (DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') - DATE_FORMAT(#{birthday},'%Y-%m-%d')) END), #{birthday},#{originType},#{originId},#{remarks},#{inservice},#{crtId},#{crtName})
mapper.select: select from patient_base_info where origin_id = #{originId} and origin_type = 3

select distinct pbi.id, pbi.org_id as orgId, pbi.`name`, pbi.pinyin_name as pinyinName, pbi.mobile, pbi.medical_number as medicalNumber, pbi.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pbi.birthday, CURDATE()) AS age, pbi.birthday, pbi.remarks, pei.patient_kind as patientKind, pei.useful_phone as usefulPhone, pei.identity, pei.profession, pei.heredity, pei.other_health as otherHealth, pmi.member_type_id as memberTypeId from patient_base_info pbi left join patient_exp_info pei on pbi.id = pei.patient_id left join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id
and IFNULL(pbi.medical_number,'') like concat('%',rtrim(#{queryForm.medicalNumber}),'%')
and concat(IFNULL(pbi.name,''),IFNULL(pbi.pinyin_name,''),IFNULL(pbi.mobile,'')) like concat('%',rtrim(#{queryForm.search}),'%')
